name: draft_scenario
title: Draft a test scenario
description: Checks a load-test scenario before anyone runs it. Takes a scenario file as kates test apply -f reads it (YAML, or JSON, which must read the same as a .json and as a YAML file), or a built-in template (kates://scenarios/{name}) with optional overrides. It parses the file as kates test apply does, converts each scenario with the CLI's scenarioToRequest, fills what a scenario leaves out with the per-type defaults Kates ships, and checks the result against the agent envelope the Kates MCP plan proposes: one scenario per file (one test at a time), an allowed test type, a set producer rate under a cap, a byte budget, at most 20 minutes, at most 50 partitions, a topic named kates-mcp-.... Returns the YAML, the request each scenario would send, its effective spec, a verdict, and findings, worst first: invalid (the CLI or backend would refuse it, it would run other than checked, or the run would fail at once), outside_envelope, and warning (it runs, but not as written: fields the backend drops, keys nothing reads, thresholds that are never graded). Warnings, then the echo of an unchanged yaml argument, are left out when the result would not fit. A scenario file has no key for the producer rate, so most types run unlimited. Saves nothing, starts nothing and sends the scenario nowhere; nothing enforces the envelope today, so the YAML is a draft for a human to review before running it.

name.description: a new name for every scenario in the file

spec_overrides.description: spec keys to set in every scenario, named as scenario files name them (records, parallelProducers, recordSizeBytes, durationSeconds, topic, partitions, ...); each a number, text or true/false

template.description: a built-in scenario template to start from, as listed under kates://scenarios/. Give this or yaml

validate_overrides.description: validate thresholds to set in every scenario (maxP99LatencyMs, maxAvgLatencyMs, minThroughputRecPerSec, maxDataLossPercent, ...)

yaml.description: a scenario file as kates test apply -f reads it: a scenarios list of name, type, spec and validate. JSON is checked both as kates test apply reads a .json file and as YAML, and must read the same both ways. Give this or template

caveats.description: what this data cannot show; read these before drawing conclusions

id.description: caveat id; kates://caveats lists every caveat with its sources

cluster.description: the Kafka cluster this result describes

id.description: the Kafka clusterId this server is pinned to

maxRecordsPerSecond.description: cap on numProducers × throughput; the plan names none, so this is this server's

findings.description: invalid first, then outside_envelope, then warning, each in file order; file-level findings have scenario -1; warnings are the first left out when the result would not fit

field.description: the key, as spec.records or validate.maxErrorRate

scenario.description: index of the scenario, or -1 for the file

effective.description: the request merged with the shipped defaults of its type, as the backend would merge it; absent when the type is unknown

bytes.description: numProducers × numRecords × recordSize, the envelope's volume

defaulted.description: fields the request leaves out, taken from the shipped defaults; a deployment can set other defaults

durationMs.description: the most the run lasts: its producer stops at numRecords or at this deadline, whichever comes first

producerTasks.description: producers the backend starts: numProducers for STRESS and CAPACITY, one for every other type

recordsPerSecond.description: numProducers × throughput, the envelope's rate; -1 when unlimited

throughput.description: records per second per producer; -1 is unlimited

topic.description: the topic the run writes to: the one given, or <type>-test, which every run of the type shares

request.description: the body kates test apply would POST to /api/tests, as scenarioToRequest builds it; zero values are left out

verdict.description: invalid when a finding is invalid; outside_envelope when one is outside the envelope; inside_envelope otherwise, warnings included; it counts findings left out to fit

yaml.description: the scenario file that was checked, ready for kates test apply -f; it was neither saved nor run

yamlOmitted.description: true when yaml is left out to fit the result: the file checked is the yaml argument, unchanged

tier.description: what the tool may do; observe tools only read

truncated.description: true when something was left out to fit one result (a list cut short, or long text dropped); narrow the request or page for the rest
